description: The producers allowed per registry.decisions type, as rows of ADR-0012's producer table (ADR-0013), with the subject each row decides about and its Provenance column (F-14): `required`, `refused` (the decision carries `requested_by` and no provenance, or reports state with no fetch behind it) or `optional`. A row may narrow the `reason` values (null for none) and the `health` values it allows. `@platform` names the 66 platform services of the service index; `*` any service of the index, here through the SDK credential client (the D3 writers have their own rows). Producer mode refuses a decision no row allows; registry-writer, the topic's one consumer, applies the same rows.
